records.title: BitcoinMarket.com opens an early BTC/USD order-book exchange
records.summary: BitcoinMarket.com began operating as an early market where buyers and sellers could discover a Bitcoin price through actual orders.
records.significance: It helped move Bitcoin valuation from formulas and private trades toward a functioning exchange market.

records.title: Laszlo Hanyecz publishes a working GPU Bitcoin miner
records.summary: Laszlo Hanyecz posted OpenCL GPU-mining software and reported significantly higher hashing performance than CPU mining.
records.significance: GPU mining accelerated Bitcoin's shift from hobby CPU mining toward specialized mining competition.

sources.title: BitcoinTalk — Generating Bitcoins with your video card

records.title: Bitcoin Pizza Day — 10,000 BTC buys two pizzas
records.summary: After offering 10,000 BTC for two pizzas on BitcoinTalk, Laszlo Hanyecz reported the successful trade on 22 May 2010.
records.significance: The pizza trade became the canonical story of Bitcoin crossing from a digital experiment into a purchase of ordinary physical goods.

records.title: Gavin Andresen launches a Bitcoin faucet giving away 5 BTC
records.summary: Gavin Andresen launched a faucet that gave each visitor 5 BTC and initially funded it with 1,100 BTC.
records.significance: The faucet made experimentation with Bitcoin easy before convenient retail exchanges and became extraordinary lore as Bitcoin later appreciated.

records.title: Slashdot coverage brings a wave of attention to Bitcoin
records.summary: Bitcoin v0.3 received attention on Slashdot and contemporary BitcoinTalk discussion recorded a sudden influx of new users.
records.significance: It was one of Bitcoin's first significant exposures to the wider technology community.

records.title: Mt. Gox launches as a Bitcoin exchange
records.summary: Jed McCaleb repurposed the mtgox.com domain, originally associated with a Magic: The Gathering card-exchange idea, into a Bitcoin exchange.
records.significance: Mt. Gox would become the dominant exchange of early Bitcoin and later the industry's most consequential early exchange failure.

records.title: Bitcoin value-overflow bug creates roughly 184 billion invalid BTC
records.summary: A value-overflow flaw was exploited at block 74,638 to create roughly 184.47 billion invalid BTC. Developers rapidly patched the software and the valid chain rejected the invalid history.
records.significance: Bitcoin's first catastrophic protocol bug demonstrated both the fragility of the early software and the network's ability to coordinate an emergency fix.

records.title: Slush Pool introduces public pooled Bitcoin mining
records.summary: Marek 'Slush' Palatinus announced a cooperative mining pool that shared block rewards among participating miners.
records.significance: Pooled mining replaced rare solo-mining jackpots with steadier proportional payouts and became the dominant organizational model for Bitcoin mining.
